separate_release_debugger.observation: IRsSendToHw receives state 22 (Texture1), then rejects its nondefault binding during original CM2SceneRender::DrawBatch. This exceeds the qualified one-unit device. Separate GDB is diagnostic, not strict execution or original rendered-pixel evidence.

contracts.selection: ShaderEffect fixed/CPU selection follows M2GetCacheFlags bit 8. Native original model passes clear inherited UI programs inside their existing state scope. Original palette preflights remain.
contracts.submission: Existing private buffer VAO submits bounded CPU position/normal/color/texture0 inputs with all initialized-fetch/index/lock/owner checks retained. GPU bone inputs are rejected. Device fixed material, four lights, linear fog, six original texture ops and texture0 matrix/sphere mapping use existing ownership. ARB fixed texgen and active fixed lighting/fog remain unavailable.
contracts.limits: 94 constants and one texture unit, required signatures and full ordered Glue digest remain. Other texture units, projected texgen and mixed fixed/ARB pipelines fail visibly. No optional required effect is silently skipped.
contracts.regression: Authored DrawBatch uses 143 bones, bone 142 in a weighted transform, nonzero original vertex start/rebased indices and translated/untranslated pixel checks; vertex constants remain unchanged. Three cycles pass per downloaded release/strict fixture on RX 7900 XTX. Separate original font/UI shader regression passes three cycles per mode.
contracts.next_blocker: Original model material attempts Texture1 while only texture unit 0 is qualified. Continue bounded original model material/multipass handling under the retained device limit before model/FFX/login frames; do not silently drop the second binding or advertise an unqualified limit.

apple_review.disposition: Re-read original SetBatchVertices in both pins and inspected WoWReMac fixed Metal pipeline selection. Reused this checkout original CPU/OpenGL contracts; no Apple source or dependency import.

limitations: One release/three untraced strict original-data executions match full ordered creation and login activation, then fail at unsupported render state with zero workers and no sanitizer finding. Separate release GDB identifies Texture1 in original model DrawBatch.

Authored CPU pixels and original font/UI shaders pass separately. No completed original ModelFFX/login frame, physical input acceptance, authentication, character selection or gameplay is established.

All client/dependency compilation ran in Actions. Both installations stayed read-only; settings/cache/logs are external. Required signatures, unaccepted original agreement state, interactive user sign-in and server/Warden policy are unchanged.

The initial fixture null-scene UBSan failure, subsequent uncleared-depth pixel failure, unsupported ARB texgen regression and superseded workflow cancellations remain recorded. A wrapper invocation before the strict artifact download completed was rejected for a missing manifest without launching the client; it is not a runtime result.
